Name: Cherry Animated Deluxe UI
Author: IkarosHDD
Description:
This a re-color of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13700]Animated Deluxe UI[/url] by NoFogBob, by default it's only uses vanilla colors.
However I really like how [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25141]Cherry Blossom UI[/url] looks and unfortunately barely any mods are compatible with it, so I took it upon myself to recolor it to work together.

If and at any time, if NoFogBob wishes me to take down this mod I will do so.

I've Only changed background of the mismatched colors of the UI, it's very possible I missed some spots here and there so please do let me know if you find them.﻿

[size=5][color=pink]~Mod Description~[/color]
[/size]
- Changes Inventory tabs to match Cherry Blossom UI
- Changes Collection tabs to match Cherry Blossom UI
- Changes Shop Status Top Right to match Cherry Blossom UI

[size=5][color=pink]~Updates~[/color]

[/size]- v1.0.1 Added Update Key

[size=5][color=pink]~Installation~[/color][/size]

[list=1]
[*][size=2]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/size]
[*][size=2]Install ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url] (Install unofficial patch by Aussiemon found here: [url=https://github.com/Aussiemon/StardewValleyMods-spacechase0/releases/tag/1.2.5]Unofficial Content Patcher Animations[/url])[/size]
[*][size=2]Install ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25141]Cherry Blossom UI[/url] (Won't work without and not much point using this with the original UI)[/size]
[*][size=2]Install ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (Lets you toggle options, however make sure you toggle the same options on this mod and the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13700]Animated Deluxe UI[/url])[/size]
[*][size=2]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13700]Animated Deluxe UI[/url] (Required as this mod only changes the UI Background to Match)﻿[/size]
[*][size=2]Install this mod through vortex or unzip into mod folder or copy contents into [b]\Stardew Valley\Mods Folder[/b][/size]
[*][size=2]Run Game Through SMAPI[/size]
[/list]
[size=5][color=pink]~Uninstallation~[/color]

[/size]Uninstall through vortex or delete from \Stardew Valley\Mods Folder
